title: Jimmy Ryan's and the move to Condon's
summary: After the Mills Cavalcade he plays Jimmy Ryan's, then is hired at the Greenwich Village Condon's over Pesky's objections.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And then I still went back. I was down at Nick's. In and out, in and out, in and out. So, uh, then I leave there. After I leave the Mills Cavalcade, uh, I went to Jimmy Ryan's for five and a half months. Did a terrific job there, thank God. And then, uh, I went down to Connors, and Connors was a little bit under the red side. And Pete Pesky asked me if I'd go to work for him. And I says, well, he says, you did a good job up at Ryan's, I hear. Well, I think I made about $55,000 with Jimmy Ryan in five months. It's not bad for a small place. Mm-hmm.
